protocol.tutorContexts: Two fresh model contexts without inherited conversation, test setup, record IDs, expected next action or private evaluator guidance. Parent retains returned tutor prose separately.
protocol.userRequest: Use minamo. Let’s continue the queue project.
protocol.permittedInterface: Normal actual compiled domainHandler MCP JSON-RPC tools/list/tools/call, carried over an isolated filesystem transport because executor loopback networks are not shared.
protocol.setup: Accelerated synthetic capture, not longitudinal human use. Seven contextual short Notes across three Investigations plus one unrelated Note, one Annotation, one bookmark, one external terminal block, and one explicit checkpoint; a Note intention was edited after that checkpoint. No consolidated resume dossier was authored. The second condition adds one independent similarly named Journey.
protocol.storage: Isolated Miniflare D1/R2 only. Both harness processes were stopped after run-named traces were frozen. No hosted test records were created, and no production records or permissions were touched.
protocol.scopeLimit: These model-based continuations do not establish measured human learning gains, reliability rates or physical Android usability.

observedOutcome.primary: Parent reports that the returning tutor recovered the post-checkpoint retry/shutdown intention and framed the next experiment as untested. Parent retains the tutor transcript separately; tool traces alone do not establish every dimension of response quality.
observedOutcome.ambiguous: Parent reports that the fresh tutor asked which of the two matching projects the learner intended and did not choose or merge their work.
observedOutcome.exactCapture: Semantic capture exact-read/persistence is separately exercised in automated interoperability acceptance; the primary fresh tutor chose an exact linked Article read, rather than an exact terminal read.
